record.question:
Fill in the blanks with the correct preposition:
(a) My parents live ________ London.
(b) Maurice is going _______ the cinema tonight?
(c) I saw Liza ________ the mall yesterday.
(d) Pauline and her family are going ______ a holiday next week.
(e) There is a bridge ________ the river.
(f) Some people always hanker ___________ money.
(g) There are many posters of Taylor Swift ______ my wall.
(h) A person must always abide ___________ the rules.
(i) Come _______ the dining room, let’s have dinner.
(j) Mt. Everest lies 8,848 meters _________ sea level. (10×1=10)
